text:
Marta: Noticing a recurring support theme: apps get a single opaque `APIError` and devs are guessing whether to retry, reauth, or show something to users. We should standardize a very small typed surface and a stable envelope so sample apps can be deterministic.

Sam: +1. Minimal error kinds I'd propose: AuthError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, SafetyReject, ServerTransient. Mandatory envelope fields: `code` (machine id), `message` (short friendly string), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (seconds, optional), `user_hint` (one-line guidance), `support_id` (opaque id for support/lookup), `signal` (for Console grouping).

Jess: Parity note: python has classes; JS currently maps everything into `Error` with string codes. For JS let's ensure `err.name` and `err.code` exist and add `retryable` boolean. For Go we should export typed error structs and an interface with `IsRetryable() bool` and `Code() string` so callers can switch on type instead of parsing messages.

Harpreet: UX/sampleapp: include a tiny error-handling component that demonstrates each case. Example flows: AuthError -> show button "Reconnect"; RateLimitError -> show countdown using `retry_after` and a disabled CTA; ValidationError -> highlight fields with `user_hint`; SafetyReject -> neutral copy + contact support with `support_id`. Put copy strings in a shared constants file so wording is consistent across sampleapps/SDKs.

Marta: Two ground rules: 1) do not expose raw stack traces in messages shown to end users; only display `support_id` if needed. 2) the envelope is a contract: clients must not rely on ad-hoc parsing of `message`.

Sam: Also recommend carrying an optional `telemetry_signal` like `quota_exceeded`, `auth_expired`, `policy_reject` to help Console auto-group and suggest remediation.

Jess: I'll draft a tiny RFC with canonical envelope and a few example snippets for js/go/python. Quick example for clarity: {
  "type": "error",
  "error": {
    "name": "RateLimitError",
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "user_hint": "Try again in a few seconds.",
    "support_id": "sup-2026-11",
    "signal": "quota_exceeded"
  }
} (this is just illustrative; servers must keep top-level envelope stable).

Harpreet: I'll build the sampleapp components and unit tests that assert the envelope fields exist for each SDK. Will also add a small e2e smoke test that drives the UI flows. ETA: Friday.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-721: "SDK error envelope: typed errors + sampleapp + parity tests" and linked this thread.

Marta: Thanks all. Let's carve out 15 minutes tomorrow to lock down exact `user_hint` copy and which SDKs get the initial PRs. @Jess @Harpreet please add RFC/PR links to DEVEX-721 when ready. :thumbsup:
